name: instaflow-ai
description: InstaFlow AI — multi-tenant Instagram automation SaaS (official Meta APIs only)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c magenta,cyan,blue "npm run dev -w @instaflow/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @instaflow/api" "npm run dev -w @instaflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @instaflow/api && npm run build -w @instaflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @instaflow/shared -w @instaflow/api -w @instaflow/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @instaflow/shared -w @instaflow/api -w @instaflow/web
